name: BloodHounds, Inc
overview: Bloodhounds, Inc. (1999–2012) is a family-oriented, Christian-based mystery series focusing on two children, Sean and Melissa Hunter, who operate a detective agency in the town of Midvale. Produced by ChristianAnswers.Net and based on stories by Bill Myers, the show features lighthearted, often supernatural-themed mysteries, such as suspected ghosts, vampires, or UFOs, intended to teach lessons about faith and responsibility.
